column5: With no opt out, Miami pays $30M

column1: * Unofficial payroll for purposes of the Competitive Balance Tax under Article XXIII of MLB collective bargaining agreement. Estimated figures in italics.
* Figures include the average annual values of contracts for players on the 40-man roster, plus about $14.5M per club for health and pension benefits.
* Tax Thresholds: Tax is assessed on amount above $195M in 2017, $197M in 2018, $206M in 2019, $208M in 2020, and $210M in 2021.
* Tax Rate: 20% for first-time payors, 30% for second-time payors, 50% for payors for three or more times. Surtax for exceeding threshold by $20M, $40M
2018: The Yankees CBT payroll of $192,980,833 did not exceed the $197M threshold for MLB's competitive balance tax.
2017,: $15.7M tax on payroll of $224,224,707 with $195M threshold and 50 percent rate, plus surtax, as a 15-time payor.
2016: $27,396,653 tax on payroll of $243,793,306 with $189M threshold and 50 percent rate as a 14-time payor.
2015: $26,108,784 tax on payroll of $241,217,569 with $189M threshold and 50 percent rate as 13-time payor.
2014: $18,326,948 tax on payroll of $225,653,896 wirh $189M threshold and 50 percent rate as a 12-time payor.
